name: Campingplatz Judenstein
beschreibung: The Judenstein campsite is located in the municipality of Rinn in Tirol and presents itself as a quiet family campsite on a sunny hillside in the Inntal. Nestled in the Tiroler mountains, the surroundings offer ideal conditions for extended hikes and mountain bike tours. The facilities include comfortable pitches, modern sanitary facilities, and a natural swimming pond for refreshment. The well-kept and quiet atmosphere invites especially families and nature lovers to relax. Thanks to its convenient location not far from Innsbruck, the site is also an ideal starting point for excursions to the provincial capital. Here, guests combine relaxed nights in nature with cultural highlights of the region.
